'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Luka and his boys repelled those thugs, he said it was a tough fight. And guess what, there's still no sign of the military, the thugs were definitely in on it with them. I guess you can find someone like our Prapor even beyond the cordon, huh? The only issues left are the good ones. They're ready to send a shipment from the other side, but it doesn't fit any of the old schemes. It's a wagonload of equipment! To get it all out, my mate demands a special fee, all in advance. The risks are too fucking high, so we have to pay. This bastard's got a bitcoin farm over there, I reckon.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[BEAR]] PMCs.

==Objectives==
* Hand over the item: 30 [[Graphics card]]
* Hand over the item: 15 [[Physical Bitcoin]]

==Rewards==
* +1 [[Crafting|Crafting skill]] level
* +1 [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]] level
* +1 [[Perception|Perception skill]] level
* +1 [[Attention|Attention skill]] level
* +1 [[Search|Search skill]] level
* +1 [[Immunity|Immunity skill]] level
* +1 [[Health|Health skill]] level
* +1 [[Surgery|Surgery skill]] level
* +1 [[Vitality|Vitality skill]] level
* +1 [[Stress Resistance|Stress Resistance skill]] level
{{quote|All right, get your stash ready. Our money's on its way.}}
